steps.executor_prompt: Open marriott.com in the default browser and verify the Marriott Bonvoy branding and domain. If an OTP entry field is already visible or Marriott explicitly says a code was sent, stop successfully. Otherwise enter {user} and {password} on the Marriott sign-in form, dismiss the keyboard, submit, and re-observe; if the populated form remains unchanged, dismiss the keyboard and submit once more. If Confirm Your Identity asks you to choose a contact method, select the email address matching {user} and tap Continue; wording that Marriott will send a code and a visible Continue button mean the request is not complete. Stop only when Marriott explicitly confirms the code was sent or displays the OTP entry field. Close only password-reset or account-recovery notices.
steps.auditor_prompt: AUDIT ONLY. Do not tap, type, swipe, or change anything on screen. Inspect the CURRENT screen state and decide whether this task was actually completed successfully: OTP has been requested/sent OR an OTP input field is visible on screen. Do not rely on memory or on what an earlier agent claimed -- judge only from what is visible right now. If you cannot clearly confirm success, treat it as not passed. Report your verdict as structured output.

steps.executor_prompt: Open the designated email or authenticator app and obtain the current one-time code for the target service. For email, return to the inbox if necessary, refresh, wait briefly, then open the newest matching verification message and read its code. For an authenticator, read the current matching code and wait for a new code if it is about to expire. Report only the OTP code as the final answer.

Return to Default Browser and the existing login.live.com page. On the Microsoft code screen, clear any existing code, tap the first code field, and type the exact OTP without spaces; segmented fields may advance and submit automatically after the last digit. Wait for the page to respond. If it does not submit automatically, use the keyboard Enter/Next action or a visible Continue/Sign in control. Report success only after the UI shows an authenticated page or explicit sign-in confirmation.
